Rudolph Fisher, The Walls of Jericho.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/rudolph-fisher/the-walls-of-jericho

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Rudolph Fisher, the author, died 1934 (Wikidata Q3446769, P570 = 1934-12-26).

First publication of the text used: 1928 (SE colophon: 'The Walls of Jericho was published in 1928 by Rudolph Fisher.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1928, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 2023.
- Country of origin: the facts do not establish the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or shorter for these deaths. The last person named above died in 1934, so the text has been public domain in each of them since 1 January 2005.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
